query: SELECT soi.id, soi.orderId, soi.productName, soi.status, soi.sentAt, soi.readyAt FROM salonOrderItems soi JOIN salonOrders so ON soi.orderId = so.id WHERE so.status IN ('OPEN', 'WAITING_PAYMENT') ORDER BY soi.id DESC LIMIT 20;
